{"Implementation approach":"Preserve protocol files exactly: requirements.txt with pytest only; runtime entry Main.py thin; single test file tests/test_main.py using python -m pytest -q. Put all reusable modules in a lowercase snake_case package named snake_game. Maintain an acyclic import graph: direction -> none; grid -> none; snake -> direction+grid; collision -> grid; random_provider -> grid; food -> grid+random_provider; game -> direction, grid, snake, collision, food, random_provider. Keep Python 3.10 only: do not use typing.Self, StrEnum, exception groups, or any Python 3.11+ APIs. For any module with forward references to its own types, start with from __future__ import annotations; otherwise, avoid forward references or quote them. Full API specification details and exact contracts repeated here:
- snake_game/direction.py owns Direction(Enum) and no other module duplicates deltas. Direction values must map to exact integer tuples: UP=(0,-1), DOWN=(0,1), LEFT=(-1,0), RIGHT=(1,0). Expose delta(self) -> tuple[int, int] returning (dx,dy), and is_opposite(self, other: Direction) -> bool rejecting immediate reversal.
- snake_game/grid.py defines only Position and Grid. Position is immutable/hashable with fields x:int, y:int. Grid validates width,height > 0 and provides in_bounds(pos: Position) -> bool. It must never mention or import Direction.
- snake_game/snake.py imports Direction and Position directly. Provide Snake mutable API: turn(requested: Direction) -> bool (reject immediate reversal), next_head() -> Position using self.direction.delta(), and advance(grow: bool) -> None mutating the body in place.
- snake_game/collision.py operates only on explicit Position/Grid/body arguments; no direction-to-delta mapping replication. Provide hit_wall(grid: Grid, pos: Position) -> bool and hit_self(body: list[Position], next_head: Position, grow: bool) -> bool treating moving into the departing tail as safe when not growing.
- snake_game/random_provider.py provides RandomProvider with deterministic behavior. It can be constructed with a pre-seeded sequence of Position objects for tests and demo. It must not depend on non-standard libraries.
- snake_game/food.py uses grid+random_provider to place food not on the snake body, only after consumption.
- snake_game/game.py exposes Game(grid: Grid, rng: RandomProvider, start: Position, direction: Direction). No second mandatory initialization call; the constructor initializes a live game. Public methods: turn(requested: Direction) -> bool, step() -> None, reset() -> None, state() -> dict, is_over() -> bool, score_get() -> int. Step semantics: compute next_head once; check wall and self collision prior to mutation; treat moving into departing tail as safe when not growing; advance once; increment score only on food; place new food only after consumption.
- Main.py defines main(), creates a deterministic RandomProvider and a valid Game, performs at most two safe steps, prints one snapshot, exits, and runs main() only under the __name__ guard.
- Tests must be deterministic and concise (2–4). Import only canonical public API symbols explicitly (no wildcards). Direction must be imported explicitly.
Deterministic fixtures:
- No-growth fixture: grid 10x10, start Position(5,5), direction RIGHT, deterministic food Position(1,1): one step results in snake [(6,5)], food (1,1), score 0, over False.
- Growth fixture: grid 10x10, start Position(5,5), direction RIGHT, deterministic food sequence [Position(6,5), Position(1,1)]: one step results in snake [(6,5),(5,5)], new food (1,1), score 1, over False.

produces Position values","snake_game/random_provider.py","domain-entity"],["Food placement using grid bounds and RandomProvider, avoiding snake body; only place after consumption","snake_game/food.py","pure-rule"],["Game orchestration: constructor initializes live state; turn, step, reset, state, is_over, score_get with exact semantics","snake_game/game.py","orchestration"],["Runtime demo: thin main(), deterministic, perform at most two safe steps, print one snapshot, exit","Main.py","environment-dependent"],["Protocol test: deterministic fixtures for no-growth and growth;     class Direction {
        +delta() tuple[int,int]
        +is_opposite(other: Direction) bool
        <<Enum>>
    }
    class Position {
        +x: int
        +y: int
        <<immutable>>
    }
    class Grid {
        -_width: int
        -_height: int
        +__init__(width: int, height: int)
        +width() int
        +height() int
        +in_bounds(pos: Position) bool
    }
    class Snake {
        -_body: list[Position]
        -direction: Direction
        +__init__(start: Position, direction: Direction)
        +turn(requested: Direction) bool
        +head() Position
        +next_head() Position
        +advance(grow: bool) None
        +body() list[Position]
    }
    class RandomProvider {
        -_queue: list[Position]
        -_seed: int

    }
    class Game {
        -_grid: Grid
        -_rng: RandomProvider
        -_snake: Snake
        -_food: Position
        -_score: int
        -_over: bool
        +__init__(grid: Grid, rng: RandomProvider, start: Position, direction: Direction)
        +turn(requested: Direction) bool
        +step() None
        +reset() None
        +state() dict
        +is_over() bool
        +score_get() int
    }
    Direction <.. Snake : uses
    Position <.. Snake : uses
    Grid <.. Game : uses
    Snake <.. Game : orchestrates
    RandomProvider <.. Game : uses
    Position <.. RandomProvider : produces
    class collision {
        +hit_wall(grid: Grid, pos: Position) bool
        +hit_self(body: list[Position], next_head: Position, grow: bool) bool
    }
    class food {
        +place_food(grid: Grid, rng: RandomProvider, occupied: set[Position]) Position
    }
    Game --> collision : checks
    Game --> food : places","Program call flow":"sequenceDiagram
    participant M as Main
    participant G as Game
    participant S as Snake
    participant C as collision
    participant F as food
    participant RP as RandomProvider
    M->>G: __init__(Grid(10,10), rng, start=(5,5), dir=RIGHT)
    G->>RP: next_position(grid)
    RP-->>G: initial food Position
    M->>G: step()
    G->>S: next_head()
    S-->>G: Position(x+dx, y+dy)
    G->>C: hit_wall(grid, next_head)
    C-->>G: False (safe)
    G->>C: hit_self(body, next_head, grow)
    C-->>G: False (safe)
    G->>S: advance(grow)
    alt food consumed
        G->>F: place_food(grid, rng, occupied)
        F->>RP: next_position(grid)
        RP-->>F: new food Position
        F-->>G: new food Position
        G->>G: score += 1
    end
    M->>G: state()
    G-->>M: {width,height,snake,food,score,over,direction}
    M-->>M: print snapshot
    M-->>M: exit","Domain Mapping":[["Direction rules and deltas (reject immediate reversal via is_opposite)","snake_game/direction.py","Defines Enum Direction with delta() and is_opposite(); no other module defines or duplicates deltas."],["Immutable Position and validated Grid bounds","snake_game/grid.py","Position(x:int,y:int) frozen dataclass; Grid(width:int,height:int) validates positive dims; in_bounds(Position)->bool; no Direction imports."],["Snake movement and mutation API","snake_game/snake.py","turn(Direction)->bool rejects immediate reversal; next_head()->Position uses direction.delta(); advance(grow:bool)->None mutates body; provides head() and body() accessors."],["Collision checks (pure functions)","snake_game/collision.py","hit_wall(Grid,Position)->bool; hit_self(body:list[Position], next_head:Position, grow:bool)->bool treating departing tail as safe when not growing."],["Deterministic randomness provider","snake_game/random_provider.py","RandomProvider with optional pre-seeded sequence of Position; next_position(Grid)->Position; no external deps; uses simple LCG fallback for demo."],["Food placement","snake_game/food.py","place_food(Grid,RandomProvider,occupied:set[Position])->Position; loops until an in-bounds, unoccupied position; only called after consumption."],["Game orchestration and state","snake_game/game.py","Game(grid,rng,start,direction) constructs live game; turn, step, reset, state (flat schema), is_over, score_get. Step computes next_head once; checks collisions before mutation; tail safety; score increment only on food; new food placed only after consumption."],["Runtime bootstrap demo","Main.py","Thin main() that wires Grid, RandomProvider (deterministic), Game; performs at most two safe steps; prints a single snapshot; __name__ guard."],["Protocol-level tests","tests/test_main.py","Two deterministic tests: no-growth and growth fixtures exactly; import canonical API explicitly; assert state schema and values."]],"Testable Core Boundary":{"pure_logic_modules":["snake_game/direction.py","snake_game/grid.py","snake_game/snake.py","snake_game/collision.py","snake_game/random_provider.py","snake_game/food.py","snake_game/game.py"],"environment_dependent_modules":["Main.py"],"test_targets_should_focus_on":["Deterministic no-growth movement (no food eaten)","Deterministic growth on food consumption","Flat state schema values (width,height,snake,food,score,over,direction)"]},"C++ Interface Plan":{},"Test Include Audit":{"declared_test_imports":["snake_game.Direction","snake_game.Position","snake_game.Grid","snake_game.Game","snake_game.RandomProvider"],"undeclared_test_includes":[],"all_test_includes_declared":true},"Protocol Compliance Check":{"build_file_preserved":true,"runtime_entry_preserved":true,"test_target_preserved":true,"required_files_missing":[],"required_files_renamed":[],"unexpected_additional_test_files":[],"noncanonical_file_references":[],"canonical_matches_file_list":true,"canonical_missing_from_file_list_copy":[],"canonical_extra_paths":[],"protocol_violations":[]},"Protocol Preservation Notes":"Build file: requirements.txt. - Module: snake_game.direction
  - class Direction(Enum): members UP=(0,-1), DOWN=(0,1), LEFT=(-1,0), RIGHT=(1,0).
    - delta(self) -> tuple[int, int]: returns (dx, dy) exactly as bound to the member; no external duplication of deltas allowed.
    - is_opposite(self, other: Direction) -> bool: returns True iff other is the immediate opposite of self; prevents reversal during Snake.turn.

- Module: snake_game.grid
  - @dataclass(frozen=True)
    class Position: fields x:int, y:int; immutable and hashable.
  - class Grid:
    - __init__(self, width: int, height: int): validates width > 0 and height > 0; raises ValueError on invalid.
    - width(self) -> int: returns configured width.
    - height(self) -> int: returns configured height.
    - in_bounds(self, pos: Position) -> bool: returns True iff 0 <= pos.x < width and 0 <= pos.y < height.
  Import rules: grid.py must not import Direction or any movement deltas.

- Module: snake_game.snake
  - class Snake:
    - __init__(self, start: Position, direction: Direction): initializes body with [start] and current direction.
    - turn(self, requested: Direction) -> bool: if requested is opposite of current direction, reject and return False; otherwise set direction and return True.
    - head(self) -> Position: returns current head Position (front of body).
    - next_head(self) -> Position: computes head advanced by current direction.delta().
    - advance(self, grow: bool) -> None: mutates body in place; inserts next_head at front; if grow is False, pops tail; if True, retains tail (growing by 1).
    - body(self) -> list[Position]: returns live reference to internal body list (tests and Game read only).
  Import rules: imports Direction and Position directly; no duplicate delta logic.

- Module: snake_game.collision
  - hit_wall(grid: Grid, pos: Position) -> bool: returns True if pos is out of bounds; otherwise False.
  - hit_self(body: list[Position], next_head: Position, grow: bool) -> bool: returns True if moving into next_head collides with the body; when grow is False, moving into the current tail is safe (tail will depart in the same tick).
  Import rules: does not import Direction; uses only arguments provided.

- Module: snake_game.random_provider
  - class RandomProvider:
    - __init__(self, sequence: Optional[list[Position]] = None, seed: Optional[int] = None): if sequence provided, use as deterministic queue; else initialize with a simple deterministic LCG seeded by 'seed' or a default.
    - next_position(self, grid: Grid) -> Position: returns the next candidate Position within grid bounds. If a sequence was provided, yields items in order (reusing last or wrapping as needed per implementation); if LCG, computes a reproducible in-bounds Position.
  Constraints: standard library only; must be deterministic for tests.

- Module: snake_game.food
  - place_food(grid: Grid, rng: RandomProvider, occupied: set[Position]) -> Position: repeatedly obtains candidates via rng.next_position(grid) until an in-bounds candidate not in 'occupied' is found; returns that Position. Called only after consumption; no side effects beyond returning a Position.

- Module: snake_game.game
  - class Game:
    - __init__(self, grid: Grid, rng: RandomProvider, start: Position, direction: Direction): constructs a live game: initializes Snake, places initial food not on snake, sets score=0 and over=False; no second init call required.
    - turn(self, requested: Direction) -> bool: forwards to Snake.turn; returns whether the turn was accepted.
    - step(self) -> None: computes next_head once; determines grow = True iff next_head equals current food; checks hit_wall and hit_self before any mutation; if collision, sets over=True and returns; else advances snake with grow flag; if grow: increments score by 1; places new food via food.place_food only after consumption.
    - reset(self) -> None: resets game to initial start, initial direction, score=0, over=False, and places a new initial food not on snake using the same rng.
    - state(self) -> dict: returns a flat dict with keys: width:int, height:int, snake:list[tuple[int,int]], food:tuple[int,int], score:int, over:bool, direction:str. Direction is a stable string name ("UP","DOWN","LEFT","RIGHT"). Snake is ordered head-first list of (x,y) tuples; food is (x,y) tuple.
    - is_over(self) -> bool: returns current terminal flag.
    - score_get(self) -> int: returns current score.
  Import graph: game.py may import direction, grid, snake, collision, food, random_provider only; must maintain acyclic imports.

- Module: snake_game.__init__
  - Exposes from snake_game import Direction, Position, Grid, Snake, RandomProvider, Game as the canonical public API.

- Module: Main.py
  - main() -> None: constructs deterministic RandomProvider and Game, performs at most two safe steps, prints exactly one state snapshot (e.g., repr or formatted dict) and exits; only runs under if __name__ == "__main__": main().

- Module: tests/test_main.py
  - Deterministically imports canonical public API symbols explicitly (no wildcards): from snake_game import Direction, Position, Grid, Game, RandomProvider. Executes two concise tests (no-growth and growth fixtures) using python -m pytest -q.

General constraints:
- Python 3.10 only; avoid typing.Self, StrEnum, exception groups, or any 3.11+ APIs.
- Maintain acyclic import graph per protocol: direction -> none; grid -> none; snake -> direction+grid; collision -> grid; random_provider -> grid; food -> grid+random_provider; game -> direction, grid, snake, collision, food, random_provider.
- For any forward references within a module referencing its own types, start with: from __future__ import annotations; otherwise avoid forward references.","Shared Knowledge":"Protocol requires preserving files exactly: requirements.txt lists pytest only; runtime entry is Main.py; single test file tests/test_main.py executed via python -m pytest -q. All reusable modules live under snake_game package with acyclic import graph. Canonical public symbols exported via snake_game/__init__.py: Direction, Position, Grid, Snake, RandomProvider, Game. Tests import only those symbols explicitly and validate deterministic domain logic through Game.state without GUI, IO, or network.","Execution Protocol":"Run: python -m pytest -q. Runtime entry: Main.py defines main(), runs only under __name__ guard, performs at most two safe steps, prints one snapshot, and exits. Single protocol-level test file: tests/test_main.py; deterministic and concise; imports only canonical exports from snake_game; no additional files alter protocol files.","Anything UNCLEAR":""}
